prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve.
Asset type: one standalone original painted Beowulf head-and-shoulders portrait-source candidate for a game's square and circular roster UI.

Input image 1 is the project's original selected ASSET-BEOWULF-001 miniature design and the only identity/style reference. Transform that full-body design into a newly composed painted bust portrait. Preserve the SAME character, face, helmet, beard, clothing, materials and muted palette; do not invent a different Viking or use any commercial illustration.

Subject: the mature broad-faced Geatish warrior shown in the reference, stern calm expression, visible eyes, weathered warm skin, long tawny-brown beard with a clear central plait and paired braided side locks. Keep the rounded dark iron helmet with its narrow antique-gold central ridge, gold brow band and descending nose guard exactly recognizable. NO horns, antlers, wings or crown. Keep the broad warm brown fur mantle, dark iron chainmail at the upper chest, brown diagonal leather strap, and the distinctive large antique-gold ring torc under the beard.

Composition/framing: square image, centered head and shoulders, straight-on face and eye contact as in the reference. Show the WHOLE helmet including its crest, whole head, both side braids and the complete beard; leave generous charcoal space above and to both sides. Helmet top around 14 percent of image height, helmet-and-head width about 38 percent of image width, beard ending around 66 percent of height. Torc visible below the beard, shoulders spreading toward the lower corners. Frame ends across the upper chest. Keep every identity-critical part of head/headgear/beard comfortably inside a centered circular crop as well as the square; no face or headgear cut at any edge. Do not paint a circle or crop guide. Omit hands, sword, shield, legs and miniature pedestal from this head-and-shoulders composition.

Style/medium: matte hand-painted miniature craft translated into a painted character portrait, with broad deliberate brush planes, tactile sculpted beard and fur, restrained painted chainmail detail and readable facial shapes. High craft, grounded and original. Avoid glossy 3D rendering, photography, realistic skin pores or cinematic spectacle.
Scene/backdrop: plain dark charcoal background, slight subdued tonal variation only, no scene, no scenery.
Lighting/mood: soft neutral-warm key from upper left, mild reflected fill to keep both eyes readable, restrained edge highlights separating the iron helmet and fur from charcoal.
Palette: iron grey #5E6266, fur brown #6E5236, muted weathered-wood brown #8B6A43 as the warm-brown family, antique-gold accent #C99A35. Preserve warm skin and brown beard from the reference; steel stays grey and gold remains a controlled accent.
Constraints: one character, one image, no words, letters, signature, frame, medallion border, watermark, logo, UI widgets or other figures. Solid charcoal background, not transparent. This is portrait source art for later review.
